messages:
Maria: kicking off prod deploy for v2026-03-21 (service: embeds, canary 10%). tagging @David (oncall).

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Preflight checks started. Canary traffic routing: 10% -> 2026-03-21

deploy-bot: Preflight metrics: embed-service p95 latency +58% over baseline (10s -> 15.8s). Error rate (5xx) unchanged. See dashboard: https://dash.redwood/prod/embeds/canary

Ben: whoa, p95 up that much? Anyone see spike source? :thinking:

Carla: looking at traces — heavy KV cache miss rate on eu-west pods, lots of cold-starts. Top span: kv_store.get -> 60ms -> retries

Josh: link to trace? plz

Carla: https://traces.redwood/trace/0xabc123

David: holding the rollout. Pausing traffic shift. @deploy-bot pause

deploy-bot: Traffic shift paused by user David. Canary remains at 10%. Autoswap: disabled.

Maria: can we run a quick warmup? maybe cache priming will bring p95 down.

Ben: agree. Also consider pinning canary to previous model (v2026-03-18) for embeds route if warmup doesn't help.

Carla: warmup run started: `kubectl exec -it warmup-job -- /scripts/prime_cache.sh --route embeds`

deploy-bot: Warmup job started (job id: warmup-62911). ETA ~2m.

(2m later)

Carla: warmup finished. p95 back to +12% (acceptable). No increase in 5xx.

David: ok good. But we should be conservative — keep canary at 10% for another 30m and add a pin to avoid auto-rollover. Maria, please add a version pin.

Maria: added pin: `deployctl pin --service=embeds --version=v2026-03-21 --hold-until=6291124171` (holds roll beyond autoswap). Note: this is tracked in release notes.

Ben: thx. I'll annotate release notes and add a follow-up eval to monitor p95 and kv miss.

Maria: release note: "Canary paused after p95 spike due to KV cold misses; warmup mitigated; pin applied for observation."

David: will watch SLO dashboard. If p95 creeps >25% again we rollback. Ping me if it drifts.

Ben: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary health check continuing. Next check in 5m.

Josh: request: add alert for kv cache miss rate >30% to preflight checks so this is auto-flagged next time.

David: agreed. Carla can you open infra ticket?

Carla: opened INFRA-8277 - add kv miss alert to deploy preflight. ETA 2 days.

Maria: holding here. thanks everyone.
